owner_listing.private_assets_note: The public author endpoint returns only public repositories. The authenticated double-scan separately observed private dataset metadata and pseudonymized those identities in the referenced estate snapshot.

scope_review.boundary: The public owner listing is complete for publicly visible dataset repositories at the observation, but it cannot enumerate private repositories and metadata screening does not approve a producer denominator. The Australian benefits track must not absorb cross-jurisdiction health funding or separate RareBurden evidence without an explicit scope decision.

estate_registry_reconciliation.boundary: All 52 catalog entries match the current authenticated-visible inventory (50 public and 2 private); 26 of 76 public datasets and 3 of 5 private datasets lack registry entries. The public reconciliation report reports a 50/50 match, which does not account for the current 81-dataset denominator. Private repository identities are not copied into this qualification. No registry mutation or rights conclusion performed.
